# foundry_voice_agent (Resource)

Manages a model-backed realtime voice agent with audio output. Changes publish a new immutable version. The resource refuses to manage definitions with fields it cannot write back, including fields nested under `audio`. It does not start sessions or bind phone numbers. Destroy deletes the agent and its versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foundry_voice_agent" "support" {
  name         = "support-voice"
  model        = "gpt-realtime"
  model_type   = "managed"
  instructions = "Help callers find the right support team. Keep replies short."
  voice        = "en-US-AvaNeural"
  voice_type   = "azure-standard"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model` (String) Managed model name or existing deployment name, depending on `model_type`.
- `model_type` (String) How the model is served: `managed` or `self_deployed`.
- `name` (String) Agent name. Changing this forces a new agent to be created.
- `voice` (String) Voice name, such as `en-US-AvaNeural`.
- `voice_type` (String) Voice implementation, such as `azure-standard` or `openai`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the agent version.
- `instructions` (String) Instructions for the voice agent.
- `store` (Boolean) Whether Foundry stores conversation content and audio. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `active_version` (String) Version receiving all stable-endpoint traffic. Resolves `@latest` to the latest version number. Null when routing is absent, split across rules, or not a single 100% `FixedRatio` rule.
- `agent_endpoint` (Attributes) ~> **Preview:** requires `enable_preview` to include `"agent_endpoints"`. Preview features may change in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

The agent's built-in endpoint, including how traffic is routed across published versions. Read-only; the service manages the remaining endpoint sub-fields (protocol configuration, authorization schemes) outside this provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_endpoint))
- `agent_guid` (String) Service-assigned unique identifier for the agent.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the agent instance identity.
- `draft` (Boolean) Whether the version is a draft. This resource publishes numbered versions only.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the current agent version, in `name:version` form.
- `principal_id` (String) Principal ID of the agent instance identity.
- `version` (String) Latest agent version number. This can differ from the version receiving endpoint traffic.

<a id="nestedatt--agent_endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_endpoint`

Read-Only:

- `protocols` (List of String) Protocols the endpoint serves, such as `responses`.
- `version_selection_rules` (Attributes List) Traffic routing rules applied to agent versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_endpoint--version_selection_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_endpoint--version_selection_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_endpoint.version_selection_rules`

Read-Only:

- `agent_version` (String) Agent version the rule applies to, or `@latest`.
- `traffic_percentage` (Number) Percentage of traffic routed to this version.
- `type` (String) Routing rule type, such as `FixedRatio`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the agent by name, not by version ID.
terraform import foundry_voice_agent.support support-voice
```
